content.short: Wallet Guard is a suite of security tools to protect crypto assets so you can browse with ease.
content.description: Wallet Guard delivers proactive phishing protection through a Chrome extension, helping you navigate web3 safely. It provides real-time alerts, detects malicious extensions, and offers a personal security dashboard. The roadmap includes transaction simulations to further test and validate your activity before you interact with transactions. Stay ahead of threats with continuous monitoring and clear, actionable security insights.
content.meta: Wallet Guard provides proactive phishing detection via a Chrome extension to help you navigate web3 safely. Discover Wallet Guard and other Web3 Wallet Tools on Lancers Web3 Explorer.

resources.title: Best Practices to Secure Your Assets
resources.tldr: Written around setting up a clean machine, which is the right frame: most compromises trace back to the environment rather than the wallet itself.

resources.title: Common Trends With Phishing in Web3
resources.tldr: Short catalogue of the patterns that recur across Web3 phishing. Dated now, but the underlying tricks have proved remarkably durable.
